notes.title: Update notes for the 'More fun' update v1.1.18 (Mar 22 2025)
notes.notes:
We listened to your feedback and the following changes have been made:


You can now drive over critters to squish them.
Proximity mines are now triggered when hit by bullets.
Improved camera movement when the mothership is selected or a selected landing vehicle/space craft is docked.
Added an auto-save function which saves the game whenever a landing vehicle is deployed or space craft is launched.
Minor improvements to UI.
You can now drive through bushes, but will still collide with trees.
Tweaked the total energy reserve and energy consumption for all landing vehicles.

notes.title: Update notes for update v1.1.17 (Dec 28 2023)
notes.notes:
Minor changes and improvements:


Improved the camera zoom and increased max zoom.
Visual improvements to alien stations for better target recognition.
When mineral tracking is enabled, the desired mineral will now be displayed in the contacts list entry of a planet as well, if it was detected on that planet.

notes.title: Update notes for update v1.1.16 (Mar 31 2023)
notes.notes:
Minor changes and improvements:


Reduced Ufo increase in numbers, scan range and respawn rate near alien stations for Easy difficulty.
Improved hinting system and feedback to indicate number of elements collected, used for repairs, assembly etc.
Added resource drops to plants, so killing them is worth the effort.
Added colour variety to elements to better indicate the different kinds of elements dropped.
Enemies will no longer disappear immediately when the player traverses on the edges of the map (was a problem when the player returned to the other side of the map).
Elements used for repairs are now deducted from storage when repairs are started, which allows the immediate use of Assembly (no longer need to wait for repairs to finish).
Assets and modules listed in the Assembly, will now show in green when they can be constructed and in grey when more elements are required for assembly (so the player can see at a glance what can be assembled).
The research button will now be highlighted when there is new research available.
Added more music.

notes.title: Update notes for update v1.1.15 (Mar 06 2023)
notes.notes:
Thanks to some great feedback the following changes have been made.

Removed randomness on starter planet for an easier start.
Increased ramming damage and reduced enemy spawn rate for Easy difficulty.
Debris is now less accurate in tracking the player.
Added game hints and a setting to remove them.
Added a warning when exiting the game without saving.

notes.title: Update notes for update v1.1.14 (Feb 02 2023)
notes.notes: Added an option under Settings to replace spiders with other creatures.
